advisoryReason: OpenCode plugins can reject a tool call, but the plugin API is moving from V1 to V2 with different tool names and inputs, and V2 plugins import a package outside Node built-ins; OpenCode was not available to prove a denial.
limits: Nothing blocks a change while working; the written rules, the scope check on the pull request and code-owner review protect the product.
The generated opencode.json uses the V2 MCP format (mcp.servers); OpenCode V1 expects servers directly under mcp.
